summary.text: Daniel Miller is the Democratic candidate for West Virginia House of Delegates District 11 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Jeffrey Sandy.
A social worker, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he works in the mental health field helping families of children with severe emotional and behavioral challenges.

paragraphs.text: Daniel Miller earned a high school diploma from Parkersburg High School and a bachelor's degree from West Virginia University at Parkersburg, and his career experience includes working as a social worker.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born and raised in the Mid-Ohio Valley, has called District 11 home for three decades, and earned his undergraduate degree, focused on psychology, while working in the service industry and volunteering.
He advanced from the Democratic primary for West Virginia House of Delegates District 11 on May 12, 2026.
Miller said in the survey that he believes in supporting the arts, investing in local organizations, and respecting individuals' right to make medical decisions with their health care providers.
